name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A sortable, paginated, selectable data table built on TanStack Table.

files.content:
"use client" import type { Table } from "@tanstack/react-table" import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@/components/ui/select" type DataTablePaginationProps = { table: Table pageSizeOptions?: number[] showSelectedCount?: boolean } function DataTablePagination({ table, pageSizeOptions = [10, 20, 50, 100], showSelectedCount = false, }: DataTablePaginationProps) { const selectedCount = table.getFilteredSelectedRowModel().rows.length const rowCount = table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length const pageCount = Math.max(1, table.getPageCount()) const pageIndex = table.getState().pagination.pageIndex const pageSize = table.getState().pagination.pageSize return (
{showSelectedCount ? (

{selectedCount} of {rowCount} row(s) selected.

) : ( )}
Rows per page

Page {pageIndex + 1} of {pageCount}

) } export { DataTablePagination }

import type { ColumnDef } from "@tanstack/react-table"

export type DataTableColumnDef<TData, TValue = unknown> = ColumnDef<
  TData,
  TValue
>
